subject: API testing
fact: API tests live in package apps/api/api_tests (not tests/) so conftest/test module names don't clash with packages/picciuli/tests under mypy and pytest; import shared helpers/fakes from api_tests.helpers. TestClient responses come from the `httpx2` dev dependency: annotate with `from httpx2 import Response` (`httpx.Response` fails mypy).
reason: Misplaced test files cause duplicate-module errors in mypy/pytest, and the wrong Response import fails the CI mypy step.

subject: web front-end
fact: apps/web is a React+TS PWA (npm, Vitest). src/api/schema.d.ts is generated from apps/api/openapi.json; CI runs `npm run check-api-types`, so run `npm run api-types` after API changes.
reason: API schema changes must regenerate the web client types or the web CI job fails.

subject: git workflow
fact: master is protected: changes must go through a pull request and history must be linear (no merge commits). Rebase/squash topic branches instead of local --no-ff merges; a push to master deploys to production.
citations: User input: "remote: - This branch must not contain merge commits. ... - Changes must be made through a pull request."
reason: Pushing local merges to master triggered ruleset violations; tasks ending with "merge to master" must rebase or squash and open a PR.
